No, Greg, I appreciate you giving me an opportunity to talk about that. It's not immigration, because if we talk immigration up here, it's like Moses parting the seas. We're working with the countries of origin of these people so that they're verifying these people are who they are. So it's either you work agriculture for five years. And if you leave that one and get caught working in one of the other ones, you've broken your commitment. And so that permit gets removed. And this will keep people honest in the profession that they said they wanted to work in. And it would clear up, it would solve about 90% of our illegal immigration. And so we can fix immigration, but focused on a guest worker program for AG hospitality and construction.
